backend/main.mo: Actor handling user profiles and habit tracking with access control, habit creation, completion state, and volume tracking logic.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence for corrected monthly volume calculations and aggregate summaries, linking related frontend files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the roles of all major frontend habit-tracking components and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind-based OKLCH color variables and light/dark theme styling.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point loading the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app wrapper with header, BecomingView, footer, authentication controls, and React Query provider.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthRequire: Alert shown when the user is not signed in, prompting login.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthStateIn: Badge showing current authentication status using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Button that signs users in or out via Internet Identity and clears cached queries on logout.
frontend/src/features/becoming/api/queri: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating habit data with actor initialization handling and error normalization.
frontend/src/features/becoming/component: Main view coordinating auth, data fetching, loading states, and rendering the habit manager, monthly summary, and habit grid.
Displays a styled error message with an optional retry button using user-friendly error text.
Renders a placeholder skeleton UI mimicking the habit grid layout during loading states.
Modal for editing a habit’s name, unit type, and volume with validation and update mutations.
Renders the habits table with day columns and rows, or a fallback message if no habits exist.
Defines shared layout constants and helpers for aligning habit grid columns.
Provides UI for adding new habits with input handling and mutation triggering.
Displays a single habit row with completion checkboxes, volume info, totals, and edit actions.
Popover providing habit actions, currently allowing users to trigger habit editing.
Aggregates and displays monthly volume totals for reps, time, or numeric habits.
Renders selectable month tabs wired to the selected month state.
frontend/src/features/becoming/constants: Defines 2026 month metadata and helpers for retrieving month info and day counts.
frontend/src/features/becoming/state/hab: Builds and queries habit completion maps and computes volume display and totals by month.
frontend/src/features/becoming/utils/tim: Validates, parses, formats, and normalizes time strings in M or M:SS formats.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithTimeout.t: Initializes an actor with a timeout, normalizes errors, supports manual retry, and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login, logout, and identity state management through a React context provider.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles and a light cyber-themed design system with custom variables and utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and renders the root component.
frontend/src/utils/icErrors.ts: Normalizes IC errors, detects stopped-canister cases, and provides user‑friendly error messages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query or hash parameters and persisting them in sessionStorage, including helpers to clear stored or hash-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, animations, and enabling plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a workout app’s volume-calculation issues, existing feature requirements for fixing monthly totals, and an active request to correct total volume aggregation.
